# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface Description

## Application Window

- **Title Bar**: Displays "ASIST-Strategic-Plan-Town-Hall.pptx - LibreOffice Impress"
- **System Tray**: Shows date and time "Oct 22 23:14" with a bell icon
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons on the top-right corner
- **Application Menu Bar**: Contains File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help

## Sidebar (Left Panel)

- **Application Icons**: Vertical dock with icons for Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC Media Player, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files, App Store, Help, and Trash
- **Slides Navigation Panel**: Shows thumbnails of slides 1 through 10, with slide 1 currently selected
- **Slide Information**: At the bottom, "Slide 1 of 18" is displayed

## Main Workspace

- **Slide Content**: Displays the first slide titled "ASIST STRATEGIC PLANNING TOWN HALL MEETING" with "ASIS PLAN" and "SEPT" visible
- **Footer**: Contains the logo "asis&t" and the text "Association for Information Science and Technology"

## Character Dialog Box

- **Title**: "Character"
- **Tabs**: Fonts, Font Effects, Position, Highlighting (with "Fonts" tab currently selected)
- **Font Family Section**:
  - **Label**: "Family:"
  - **List Box**: Displays font options including "Liberation Sans Narrow", "Liberation Sans", "Liberation Serif", "Libre Franklin", "Likhán", "LKLUG", "Lohit Assamese", "Lohit Bengali", "Lohit Devanagari", "Lohit Gujarati"
  - **Selection**: "Liberation Sans Narrow" is highlighted
- **Font Style Section**:
  - **Label**: "Style:"
  - **List Box**: Displays style options including "Regular", "Bold", "Italic", "Bold Italic"
  - **Selection**: "Regular" is highlighted
- **Font Size Section**:
  - **Label**: "Size:"
  - **List Box**: Displays size options including "18 pt", "20 pt", "21 pt", "22 pt", "24 pt", "26 pt", "28 pt", "32 pt", "36 pt", "40 pt"
  - **Selection**: "18 pt" is highlighted
- **Language Section**:
  - **Label**: "Language:"
  - **Dropdown**: Currently set to "English (Hong Kong)"
- **Note**: "The same font will be used on both your printer and your screen."
- **Preview Area**: Displays "Liberation Sans Narrow" as a sample text
- **Action Buttons**: Help, Reset, Cancel, OK

## Properties Panel (Right Panel)

- **Title**: "Properties"
- **Slide Section**:
  - **Format**: "Widescreen" (dropdown)
  - **Orientation**: "Landscape" (dropdown)
  - **Background**: "None" (dropdown)
  - **Insert Image...** button
  - **Master Slide**: "Title Slide" (dropdown)
  - **Master Background**: Checkbox selected
  - **Master Objects**: Checkbox selected
  - **Master View** button
- **Layouts Section**:
  - **Title**: "Layouts"
  - **Layout Grid**: Displays various slide layout options with one layout selected (highlighted with a red border)

## Top Toolbar

- **Standard Toolbar**: Contains icons for file operations, editing, formatting, slide management, and more
- **Help Banner**: Two informational banners at the top of the workspace
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with "Get involved" and "Donate" buttons
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community."

## Status Bar

- **Slide Information**: "Title Slide"
- **Coordinates**: "0.86 / -1.70"
- **Dimensions**: "0.00 x 0.00"
- **Language**: "English (USA)"
- **Zoom Level**: "92%" with zoom slider

## System Interface

- **Desktop Environment**: Ubuntu-based desktop with Activities button on the top-left
- **System Icons**: Sound, network, and power icons on the top-right
- **Window Management**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons on the top-right of the LibreOffice window
